notes.title: Demo Release!
notes.content:
[h2]
The demo for Rollo Boi is finally available! ːsteamhappyː[/h2][p]I know I should have posted a demo before releasing the full game. I was excited, and extremely hopefull for everyone to see the project. Posting the game before the demo was released caused me some issues with the game its self. No one wants to play a game they can not demo and I understand that now. I plan to keep you all updated on upcoming releases! For now... We have a demo![/p][p][/p][h2]What is included in the demo?[/h2][p]The demo is a shorter version of the final game. It only consists 5 levels that are available in the full version of the game. I would recommend using the controller to play, but the keyboard is available to use as well![/p][p][/p][p]If you have any issues or questions please feel free to comment down below![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45489547/d2b6634da3353a31a7f69505bdaf80099c552486.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Dpad Suppot added!
notes.content:
[h2]Dpad support has been added to Rollo Boi![/h2]

There are limitations to the game engine I used to make Rollo Boi. I am working twards making thumbstick compatibility available for everyone! For now the Dpad can be used as an alternative control scheme to help Rollo Boi roll more effectively! Thankyou to everyone who has purchased the game! I will be posting a 50% OFF SALE SOON!

tags.feature: Dpad support has been added to Rollo Boi!

notes.title: World 6 Live!
notes.content:
[h1]World 6 Update – Defying Gravity![/h1]

[h3]Brace yourself for a whole new challenge! World 6 introduces low gravity physics![/h3]

[h1]5 Brand-New Levels![/h1]

[h3]Test your skills across five fresh, mind-bending stages, where movement feels different than ever before.
[/h3]

[h1]Low Gravity Mechanics![/h1]

[h3]Gravity is weaker here, meaning higher jumps and slower descents. Master the floaty physics to navigate obstacles like never before![/h3]

[h1]New Challenges Designed for Low Gravity![/h1]

[h3]Prepare for precision jumps, tricky platforming sections, and movement that demands full control. It’s all about adapting to the new environment![/h3]

[h1]Limited Powerups For this world![/h1]

[h3]Jumping is your only boost, and no other powerups are available. Strategy and skill will be your best allies here![/h3]

[h1]One more achievement added for world 6![/h1]

[h3]Play through and beat  world 6 to show off your achievement hunting skills to your friends![/h3]

notes.title: World 6 Development Has Been Slow
notes.content:
[h2]Sorry for the delay in the update![/h2]

[h3]World 6 has not been worked on for very long due to life getting ahead of me...

I have been working a lot at my job and I am not always gaurenteed time to develop videogames...
Hopefully soon I will find the time to make the changes needed to add a new challenge to world 6! Low gravity mode! Having lower gravity in world 6 has proven to be challenging. It changes the entire dynamic of Rollo Bois character model thus creating a slew of new bugs that i need to tackle before i send the game update to you guys! Hopefully by the end of this month I will have a great update for you all to see![/h3]

tags.bug: new bugs that i need to tackle

notes.title: Rollo Boi World 6 Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[b][h1]Rollo Boi is going to space?[/h1][/b]

[h3][u][b]Yes! Rollo Boi is going to outer space in the new FREE update for Rollo Boi![/b][/u][/h3]

[h3][b]The world 6 update will include the following![/b][/h3]

[b]New Levels:[/b] 5 New levels will be included in the new update!

[b]Accessibility Mode:[/b] Move Rollo Boi with the D-Pad if preferred!

[b]Achievements:[/b] New achievements will be available and up for grabs!

As of right now there is no scheduled release date for the update but i am hoping to have it out by April!

I hope you all will enjoy the free update when it comes! I have a few more ideas in store for future updates!

notes.title: Music Playlist Update!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Updated music selection for game.[/b] Now when you load up Rollo Boi, it will play a selection of songs randomly one after another![/h2]


[h2]If you want to listen to the music in the update you can hear it from all major streaming services. I composed all this music over a year ago and decided its time for it to be heard![/h2]

[u]Due to the nature of these updates there is a chance your save files could be lost. There is no real way for me to test this. I do not believe changing the music will cause such an issue.[/u]
Update will be out at roughly [b]9PM EST[/b]
